en.headline: Golden Fortune and Audacious Pursuit win at Happy Valley
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club carded a nine-race night meeting on the C+3 course, with the ground rated good to firm.
body: Golden Fortune won the opening Bedford Handicap at Happy Valley on Wednesday night, according to results published by the Hong Kong Jockey Club. The Class 5 race over 1,800 metres was run on the turf C+3 course, with the going rated good to firm.

Brenton Avdulla rode the K L Man-trained gelding to finish in 1:49.66. Kingly Demeanor, ridden by Matthew L Yeung for A S Cruz, was a length and a half behind in second, with Good Luck Win third. The win dividend was $47.50. Can't Go Wong, the 4-1 favourite ridden by Zac Purton, finished eighth.

Later on the card, Audacious Pursuit took the Hing Fat Handicap, a Class 3 contest over 1,650 metres worth $2.05 million. Ellis Wong rode the Caspar Fownes-trained horse to win in 1:38.30 at a starting price of 10-1. Rising Phoenix, with P N Wong aboard for David Hall, was a short head behind in second. Prestige Good finished third. The win dividend was $102.50.

The Club also recorded Sunday's Serenade, ridden by Zac Purton for Jamie Richards, as the winner of the Fat Tseung Handicap, a Class 4 race over 1,650 metres. The meeting was the Wednesday night fixture at Happy Valley.

zh.headline: 跑馬地夜賽金運來及大膽追擊勝出
zh.dek: 馬會周三在跑馬地草地C+3跑道舉行九場夜賽，場地評為好地至快地。
body: 根據香港賽馬會公布的賽果，周三晚跑馬地首場 Bedford Handicap 由 Golden Fortune 勝出。這是一場第五班、途程1800米的草地賽，場地評為好地至快地，跑道為C+3。

Golden Fortune 由 Brenton Avdulla 策騎、K L Man 訓練，跑出1分49.66秒。第二名是 A S Cruz 馬房、Matthew L Yeung 策騎的 Kingly Demeanor，落後一個半馬位；Good Luck Win 跑第三。獨贏派彩為47.5元。大熱門、F C Lor 馬房的 Can't Go Wong 由 Zac Purton 策騎，最終跑第八。

同晚稍後的 Hing Fat Handicap，由 Audacious Pursuit 勝出。這是第三班、1650米、獎金205萬元的賽事。Caspar Fownes 馬房的 Audacious Pursuit 由 Ellis Wong 策騎，以10倍獨贏賠率跑出1分38.30秒。第二名是 David Hall 馬房、P N Wong 策騎的 Rising Phoenix，只落後短馬頭；第三名是 Prestige Good。獨贏派彩為102.5元。
馬會亦錄得 Jamie Richards 馬房、Zac Purton 策騎的 Sunday's Serenade 勝出第四班、1650米的 Fat Tseung Handicap。這是周三晚跑馬地的夜賽日賽事。
